name: Learning Loop Status
description: Monitor Thompson Sampling, pattern extraction, and learning system health

prompt.template: Query Thompson Sampling scores for all active templates. Display as a scatter plot or table with: Template Name, Alpha (successes), Beta (failures), Expected Success Rate, Confidence Interval.

Query for recent template creations that were extracted from successful executions (ribosome pattern). Display as a timeline or table showing: Timestamp, Source Execution ID, New Template ID, Category.
Show how Thompson Sampling scores have changed over time for top templates. Create line charts showing alpha and beta evolution for templates with >10 executions.
Analyze recent template selections to calculate exploration rate (selecting non-optimal templates) vs exploitation rate (selecting optimal templates). Display as gauges or pie chart.
Query impulse relevance scores to see which impulse types are most correlated with successful executions. Display as a ranked table or bar chart.
List template variants currently being A/B tested via Thompson Sampling. Show: Base Template, Variant Count, Traffic Distribution, Statistical Significance.
